authority_note: Worker amendment only; no canonical file written, no gate verdict, no node status, no validation_status=passed.
supersedes: AMEND-01 anchor statement where contradicted below; AMEND-01's static_pin_digest and the HF-059-FROZEN-01 finding stand.

defects.description: check_frozen_gen_census.py wrote its focused extract to the fixed path stale_binding_census.json on every run, including --corpus-from verification runs that wrote their report elsewhere. The 01:11:45 verification run therefore overwrote the canonical focused extract with one derived from /tmp/w059_verify.json, and that /tmp-derived file (sha256 322a23dd3d52) is what the 01:12:30 artifact event pinned.
defects.evidence: Rebuilding the focused extract from /tmp/w059_verify.json reproduces 322a23dd3d52 exactly; rebuilding it from the pinned report.json yields aa3733f7cfc1.
defects.fix: The harness now derives the focused output path from --out (canonical report.json keeps the published name) and gained --focused-from/--focused-out for non-destructive regeneration. A smoke run with --out /tmp/w059_smoke.json and a subsequent verifier run both leave report.json (1893028ee4ab) and stale_binding_census.json (aa3733f7cfc1) unchanged.

defects.description: The 213-file pinned review corpus is not byte-stable: other agents rewrite their own review artifacts. At verification time 2 of the 213 pinned files had been rewritten (reviews/F2a-review-rev27-a.json, reviews/F2b-review-worker-072-rev29.json) and 8 new review files had appeared, so a fresh --corpus-from run parses 211 rows and its review_census_digest necessarily differs from edf82c4d35fa. This is a corpus-drift observation, not a defect in the pin core.
defects.impact_on_findings: None on HF-059-FROZEN-01: neither drifted file is in the stale-binding set (both were generation-B-bound rows with unresolved worker-artifact hashes). The 33 stale rows and the single post-freeze stale full-schema accept (F2a-review-worker-017) are unaffected.

final_anchors.static_pin_digest_status: reproducible: C1 PASS on every verifier run; covers generations, changed pins, class scan, superseded hashes, pin resolution, expectations, amendments, recovery booleans
final_anchors.review_census_digest_status: conditional: reproducible only while the 213 pinned review files are byte-stable; see D3

amended_falsifier: Re-run verify_reproducibility.py and check: C1 (static_pin_digest 7f23d65b5fc741ad), C3, C4, C5 must PASS; C2 passes iff the 213 pinned review files are byte-stable, otherwise the drift set must match a fresh census of changed review bytes and no stale-binding row may move. Falsified if static_pin_digest changes, if any pinned input re-hashes differently, if any expectation E1-E12/E13b or mutant/control changes result, if HF-059-FROZEN-01's stale row set changes under the drifted corpus, or if the canonical focused extract no longer derives from report.json.
process_note: Both defects were self-detected by executing the emitted falsifier before task exit and are recorded rather than silently repaired; the fix is pinned by a superseding artifact event.
